✦ a poem, written just for you

You are my favourite chapter

From the tiny benches of LKG,

to the last bell of the 12th grade —

You were always the plot twist I never saw coming,

the kind no mystery book could've made.

✦ ✦ ✦

We sang when we shouldn't have,

danced like nobody was watching (they were),

got punishments for laughing too loud in English Club —

and honestly? I'd do it a million times more.

✦ ✦ ✦

The lunches that stretched way too long,

the gossip that went on for miles,

the food we shared, the grounds we played,

a whole lifetime of stolen smiles.

✦ ✦ ✦

When school ended, so did many things —

but you chose to stay. You actually chose me.

And that, my dearest Thasleema,

is the loveliest thing anyone's ever done. 💛

✦ our official friendship timeline

From LKG to forever

LKG · The Beginning

Two tiny humans land on the same school bench. Neither knows yet this is the start of a lifelong story. One of them probably already had strong opinions about yellow things.

Primary School · The Chaos Era

Lunch breaks that became legendary 2-hour gossip sessions. Punishments we wore like badges. Games on the ground, songs sung too loud, jokes that made our stomachs hurt.

English Club · The Creative Era

Speeches. Articles. Competitions. We did it all — together. Writing for the school magazine, comparing notes, working late. Two creative souls making loud, glorious messes.

Tournaments & Ground Games · The Athlete Era

Running, playing, winning, losing — always beside each other. The ground was our arena. The crowd was just background noise. We showed up. Always.

High School · The Deep Talks Era

Silly, senseless jokes. Then the most mature conversations you could imagine. You were the one who could do both, seamlessly. Who made me feel understood and laughed-at in the same breath.

After School · The Choice

School ended. Friendships faded. But you chose to stay. In a world where everything changes — you stayed constant. That makes you irreplaceable. That makes you mine.

Today · Your Birthday · Forever

Here we are. Still laughing. Still each other's person. Here's to every chapter we haven't written yet. 💛
